scope: Read-only assessment of installed lossless compressors and exact compressed-payload redundancy in the immutable checkpoint06. No source archive modified.
method: Read every raw compressed ZIP member payload at its recorded local-header offset, SHA256 each payload, and compare byte-identical hashes with the latest prior occurrence. Report sums and byte distances; this estimates redundancy, not a measured completed XZ result.

counter_only_trial.reason: Stopped on root instruction to produce the actual transport rather than continue a disposable counter-only measurement.

selected_alternative: Root/CDP independently established exact-byte PNG deduplication in a standard flat ZIP at approximately428.9MB. Root owns actual output, per-member hash verification and full restoration manifest; this assessment does not invent their final archive hash.
preservation: Original and earlier checkpoints remain untouched. Partial XZ stream is retained with its actual hash and exit130; it is expressly unusable as a completed transport.
